buyFlare.label: Flare
buyFlare.description: Spend 5 RF. Gain a pulse and push the corrupted Friends back.

holdMaze.label: Hold this maze
holdMaze.description: Spend 10 RF. The walls stop shifting for the rest of this run.

buyQuiet.label: Quiet
buyQuiet.description: Spend 8 RF. The corrupted Friends lose you and wander until the next day.

buyScout.label: Scout
buyScout.description: Spend 6 RF. The minimap fills in, including the exit.

buyCowl.label: Night Cowl
buyCowl.description: Spend 4 RF. A black cowl with pointed ears and white eyes.

buyGrin.label: Red Grin
buyGrin.description: Spend 6 RF. A pale mask, green hair, and a red smile.

buySkull.label: Skull
buySkull.description: Spend 8 RF. A bone mask with black eyes.

buyVisor.label: Visor
buyVisor.description: Spend 10 RF. A gold plate with a dark eye slit.

buyChance.label: Second chance
buyChance.description: Spend 15 RF. Once this run, dying returns you to the Glade.
